summary.headline: Medical Prognostics and Zodiacal Rulerships
summary.text: Codex entries for lunar prognostics, good and bad days, zodiacal rulerships, medical calculations concerning illness, life, and death, and five astrological diagrams. Also describes King Alexander’s seven planetary herbs and a zodiacal melothesia diagram assigning signs to body parts, including Leo-heart, Taurus-neck, Pisces-feet, and Sagittarius-thighs.
